hassio_confirm.title: Spotify Flex Player
hassio_confirm.description: The Spotify Flex app was found. Create the player and speaker entities in Home Assistant?

user.title: Spotify Flex Player
user.description: Normally this sets itself up from the app. The API token is shown in the app settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Spotify Flex Player
reauth_confirm.description: The API token no longer matches. Enter the current token from the app settings.

error.cannot_connect: The Spotify Flex app is not reachable.

abort.already_configured: Spotify Flex is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: The Spotify Flex app is not reachable.

types.name: Types
types.description: track, artist, album, playlist, show, episode, audiobook.

queue.name: Queue
queue.description: Returns the current and upcoming items.

like.name: Liked songs
like.description: Get, save, remove or toggle (no URI: current item).

uri.name: Spotify URI
uri.description: Optional, defaults to the current item.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Pause playback after the given time (0 = off).

equalizer.name: Equalizer
equalizer.description: Get or set the equalizer (no fields: current settings as response).

enabled.name: On
enabled.description: Switch the equalizer on or off.

gains.name: Bands
gains.description: 6 values in dB (-12 … 12) for 60 Hz, 150 Hz, 400 Hz, 1 kHz, 2.4 kHz, 15 kHz.

announce.name: Announcement
announce.description: Plays TTS, news or other audio URLs in sync on the Spotify Flex speakers; Spotify is paused and speaker volumes are restored afterwards.

media.name: Media
media.description: List of media_content_id (http(s) URL or media-source://…, e.g. TTS) and optional volume (0–100).

group.name: Group
group.description: Speaker group (name) to switch on first.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Return only when everything has been played.
